areas.name: Downtown Core
areas.description: Jefferson Street, Main Street and Vermilion Street around the downtown core
areas.productImplication: Highest-density launch zone. Six places share one navigable experience and Magnolia adds a separate nearby interior. Treat street transitions and model handoffs as first-class UX.
areas.validationBeforeCommitment: Confirm exact shared-model spatial limits, public-right-of-way filming contacts and loading/parking rules

areas.name: Sterling Grove / North Sterling
areas.description: North Sterling Street northeast of downtown
areas.productImplication: Adds a historic residential/hospitality context outside the downtown commercial cluster.
areas.validationBeforeCommitment: Resolve 324 vs 338 N Sterling address and present owner/booking authority

areas.name: Johnston Street / Moncus / Blackham
areas.description: Johnston Street corridor southwest of downtown
areas.productImplication: Connects retail, park landscape and a future historic arena. These are separate properties and should remain separate permission packages.
areas.validationBeforeCommitment: Validate corridor map framing, each property boundary, parking/loading and event calendars

areas.name: Northside / Clara Street
areas.description: Former Truman campus north of downtown
areas.productImplication: Extends coverage north to a former institutional campus with uncertain current occupancy and authority.
areas.validationBeforeCommitment: Confirm current lease, custodian, safe access, occupied zones and hazard documentation

areas.name: Cajundome / South Campus
areas.description: Cajundome Boulevard and West Congress complex west of UL's main campus
areas.productImplication: Largest future scan cluster. Design a campus-scale hierarchy: complex, facility, entrance, interior zone and sweep.
areas.validationBeforeCommitment: Coordinate university/venue approvals, event blackouts, credentials, privacy, parking and scan scheduling

areas.name: UL Main Campus
areas.description: Main academic campus centered around University Circle
areas.productImplication: A campus record is too broad for production use. Subdivide into named buildings, quads, streets, entrances and controllable zones before scanning.
areas.validationBeforeCommitment: Build a campus sublocation inventory and confirm university-wide approval workflow

areas.name: UL Research Park
areas.description: University research facilities along Eraste Landry Road north of the Cajundome complex
areas.productImplication: Keep laboratory, solar-field and building access zones distinct from nearby sports facilities.
areas.validationBeforeCommitment: Confirm research schedules, authorized zones, facility access and equipment safety
